title: Max, Our Dog
text:
Max is a small brown dog. He lives with my family in a house near the park. Every morning, I give him water and food. He likes to run in the garden.

Pets need love and care. We take Max to the vet once a year. The vet checks his health and gives him medicine. Max is happy and healthy.

questions.text: Where does the family take Max once a year?
How does the family probably feel about Max?
options: They care about him a lot

questions.text: What can you infer about the job of a vet?
options: The vet helps keep animals healthy

paragraph_translations: Max es un perro pequeño y marrón. Vive con mi familia en una casa cerca del parque. Cada mañana, le doy agua y comida. Le gusta correr en el jardín.
Las mascotas necesitan amor y cuidado. Llevamos a Max al veterinario una vez al año. El veterinario revisa su salud y le da medicina. Max está feliz y sano.
